intro: El Salvador is the only Central American country without a Caribbean coast.

chapters.title: Volcanoes and coast
text: Over 20 volcanoes rise across the country, including Santa Ana and Izalco. Lake Coatepeque fills a volcanic crater. The Pacific coast has famous surf at El Tunco and El Zonte.

chapters.title: Earthquakes
text: Earthquakes are frequent; San Salvador is sometimes called the 'valley of hammocks' because the ground sways.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake in a volcano's crater.
